desc:
Welcome to Drive For Eggs!🥚

🎮 How to Play:

🚗 Ram eggs with your car to hatch rare animals
🐾 Steal them onto your roof and outrun the guards
💰 Drive them home to your base to earn cash
⚡ Train horsepower on the dyno and unlock faster cars
💥 Ram other players to knock their animals off
🏆 Collect them all in the Index for exclusive car effects!

❤️ Like the game and join the group for free rewards!
